description: Botulax is a botulinum toxin type A injectable manufactured by Hugel, Inc. of South Korea. It is one of the most widely exported Korean neurotoxins, supplied as a lyophilised powder for reconstitution and positioned as a cost-effective, established aesthetic toxin. It is marketed internationally under names such as Regenox and Botulift in some territories.
howItWorks: As a botulinum toxin type A, it cleaves SNAP-25 in the SNARE complex to block acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction, temporarily relaxing the injected muscle. The clinical effect is reversible as new nerve terminals form over time.
composition: Active ingredient is Clostridium botulinum toxin type A complex, stabilised with human serum albumin and sodium chloride. Supplied as a freeze-dried (lyophilised) white powder in 100 U, 200 U and 300 U vial strengths.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with sterile preservative-free 0.9% sodium chloride before use. Store refrigerated at 2-8C; use the reconstituted solution within the manufacturer's recommended window. Units are product-specific and not interchangeable with other botulinum toxin brands.
benefits: Established, high-volume aesthetic brand
Cost-effective option for high-throughput practices
Flexible dosing across vial sizes
Familiar handling for clinicians used to complex-type toxins

description: Meditoxin is a botulinum toxin type A produced by Medytox Inc., one of Korea's first domestically developed neurotoxins. It is exported under several regional brand names, including Neuronox, Siax, Botulift and Cunox. It is a conventional complex-type toxin positioned as an established, broadly available aesthetic product.
howItWorks: The type A toxin blocks acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction by cleaving SNAP-25, producing temporary, localised relaxation of the treated muscle. Muscle activity gradually returns as nerve signalling is restored.
composition: Active ingredient is purified Clostridium botulinum toxin type A complex, with human serum albumin as a stabiliser and sodium chloride as a tonicity agent. Supplied as a lyophilised white powder in 100 U and 200 U vials.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% saline prior to injection. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and use within the recommended post-reconstitution period. Dosing units are specific to this product and not convertible to other toxins.
features: Available in 100 U and 200 U vials
Sold internationally under multiple brand names
benefits: Long-established Korean neurotoxin with wide distribution
Predictable handling for practitioners familiar with complex toxins
Multiple vial sizes for dosing flexibility
Cost-competitive aesthetic option

description: Nabota is a botulinum toxin type A developed by Daewoong Pharmaceutical of South Korea, produced with a proprietary high-purity manufacturing process. The same product is marketed as Jeuveau in the US and Canada and as Nuceiva in Europe and Australia. It is positioned as a highly purified, preservative-free aesthetic neurotoxin.
howItWorks: It acts as a type A botulinum toxin, cleaving SNAP-25 to inhibit acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction and temporarily relax the targeted muscle. The effect is dose-dependent and reversible.
composition: Active ingredient is Clostridium botulinum toxin type A (approximately 900 kDa complex), with human serum albumin and sodium chloride as excipients; the formulation is preservative-free. Supplied as a lyophilised powder, commonly in a 100 U vial, produced via Daewoong's proprietary high-purity purification technology.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% saline before injection. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and use within the recommended window after reconstitution. Units are product-specific and not interchangeable with other toxins.
benefits: High-purity toxin with international regulatory footprint
Preservative-free for sensitive patients
Backed by an internationally approved equivalent (Jeuveau/Nuceiva)
Consistent, predictable aesthetic performance

description: Innotox is a ready-to-use liquid botulinum toxin type A from Medytox Inc., marketed as the first pre-mixed liquid neurotoxin, eliminating the reconstitution step required by conventional lyophilised toxins. It is an animal-protein-free formulation positioned for convenience and dosing consistency in aesthetic practice.
howItWorks: As a type A toxin, it blocks acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction via SNAP-25 cleavage, temporarily relaxing the treated muscle. The mechanism and reversibility are the same as other type A toxins.
composition: Active ingredient is botulinum toxin type A supplied as a sterile pre-mixed liquid. It is an albumin-free / animal-protein-free formulation (no human serum albumin or gelatin), available in 50 U and 100 U presentations.
usageNotes: Supplied pre-diluted as a ready-to-use liquid, so no reconstitution is required, which reduces preparation error and dilution variability. Store refrigerated at 2-8C. As with all toxins, units are product-specific and not interchangeable.
benefits: Eliminates reconstitution and reduces preparation error
Consistent dosing from a standardised dilution
Suited to patients preferring animal-protein-free products
Time-saving workflow for busy clinics
indications: Perioral and other dynamic facial wrinkles

description: Coretox is a botulinum toxin type A from Medytox Inc. formulated as a complexing-protein-free 'core' neurotoxin. It is manufactured without human serum albumin and without animal-derived materials, and is positioned as a purified toxin intended to minimise foreign-protein load. It is used for aesthetic and therapeutic muscle-relaxation indications.
howItWorks: The core 150 kDa type A neurotoxin cleaves SNAP-25 to block acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction, producing temporary, localised muscle relaxation. Removing complexing proteins does not change the fundamental mechanism.
composition: Active ingredient is the pure 150 kDa botulinum neurotoxin type A, free of complexing (accessory) proteins. Notably manufactured without human serum albumin and without animal-derived components; supplied as a lyophilised powder, commonly in a 100 U vial.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% saline to form a clear, colourless solution before injection. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and use within the recommended window. Units are product-specific and not interchangeable with other toxins.
benefits: Reduced foreign-protein load may lower immunogenic potential
Suitable for patients preferring albumin- and animal-protein-free products
Purified formulation positioned for repeat/long-term use
Predictable clinical handling

description: Dysport (abobotulinumtoxinA) is a botulinum toxin type A manufactured by Ipsen. It is a long-established, regulatory-approved neurotoxin used in both aesthetic and therapeutic settings, characterised by relatively smaller toxin complexes than conventional 900 kDa products. It is widely used for glabellar lines and a range of movement/spasticity indications.
howItWorks: AbobotulinumtoxinA blocks acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction by cleaving SNAP-25, temporarily relaxing the injected muscle. The effect is dose-dependent and gradually reverses.
composition: Active ingredient is abobotulinumtoxinA, supplied as a lyophilised powder with human serum albumin and lactose as excipients. Available in 300 U and 500 U vials. Its dosing units are unique to Dysport and cannot be converted to other botulinum toxins.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% saline before intramuscular injection. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and use within the labelled window after reconstitution. Dysport units are not interchangeable with Botox, Xeomin or any other toxin.
benefits: Long-established, internationally approved brand
Broad aesthetic and therapeutic evidence base
Well-characterised diffusion/spread profile
Larger vial sizes suit higher-volume treatment areas
indications: Crow's feet and forehead lines (aesthetic use)

description: Xeomin (incobotulinumtoxinA) is a botulinum toxin type A from Merz, notable for being free of complexing proteins - often called the 'naked toxin.' It delivers only the pure active neurotoxin molecule, a formulation intended to reduce foreign-protein exposure. It is approved for aesthetic and therapeutic indications.
howItWorks: IncobotulinumtoxinA cleaves SNAP-25 to inhibit acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction, temporarily relaxing the treated muscle. Removal of complexing proteins does not alter the core mechanism of action.
composition: Active ingredient is the pure 150 kDa botulinum neurotoxin type A, free from complexing (accessory) proteins, with human serum albumin and sucrose as excipients. Supplied as a lyophilised powder in 50 U, 100 U and 200 U vials.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% saline before injection. Xeomin can be stored at room temperature prior to reconstitution per its labelling, then handled per instructions after reconstitution. Units are product-specific and not interchangeable with other toxins.
benefits: Minimal accessory-protein load, positioned to reduce immunogenic potential
Established brand with strong therapeutic and aesthetic evidence
Convenient pre-reconstitution storage flexibility
Predictable, well-characterised clinical performance

description: Botox (onabotulinumtoxinA) from Allergan (an AbbVie company) is the original and most extensively studied botulinum toxin type A. It is a 900 kDa neurotoxin complex used across a wide range of aesthetic and therapeutic indications, and serves as the reference brand for the category. Its dosing units ('Allergan Units') are specific to the product.
howItWorks: OnabotulinumtoxinA blocks acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction by cleaving SNAP-25, temporarily relaxing the injected muscle. The effect is localised, dose-dependent and reversible over time.
composition: Active ingredient is onabotulinumtoxinA, a Clostridium botulinum toxin type A neurotoxin complex (approximately 900 kDa), formulated with human serum albumin and sodium chloride. Supplied as a vacuum-dried powder in 50 U, 100 U and 200 U vials.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% saline before injection. Store refrigerated at 2-8C (vials may also be stored frozen per labelling) and use the reconstituted solution within the recommended window. Allergan Units are unique to Botox and not convertible to any other toxin.
benefits: Category reference brand with the largest clinical evidence base
Broad range of approved aesthetic and therapeutic indications
Highly predictable, well-documented performance
Strong brand recognition and patient trust
indications: Hyperhidrosis, chronic migraine and other therapeutic uses
